Band widths represent paired-task counts; in-band numbers highlight the largest cross-outcome flows. “Zero” includes zero scores and construction failures; “Invalid” includes missing or unparsable submissions and construction failures.(b)Category-level effects across all six settings. Rows represent Harness-Bench task categories and NewtonBench physical mechanisms; columns represent Targets. Bars show score differences between full-bank and no-skill Builders with unadjusted 95% task-bootstrap confidence intervals. Purple dashed lines indicate setting’s overall effect.
